genxml.title: TIOCP registers and constants outside the census
genxml.doc: SGI's Linux Altix platform code (v5.3) defines the TIOCP register block as struct tiocp. The census unit holds the offsets the shipped IRIX accessors reach; this unit holds what the header defines beyond them and the constants of the provider. Names, offsets and layouts are software definitions.

struct.name: STAT
struct.doc: Widget status (`cp_stat`), second word of the standard widget block. Offset, width and name are the header definition. Access direction is not stated; no code read reaches it, so its behaviour is unknown.

struct.name: ERR_UPPER
struct.doc: Widget error address, upper word (`cp_err_upper`); the lower word is the census register `bus_err`. Offset, width and name are the header definition. Access direction is not stated; no code read reaches it, so its behaviour is unknown.

struct.name: INTR_UPPER
struct.doc: Widget interrupt destination, upper word (`cp_intr_upper`); the lower word is the census register `intr_dst_target_id`. Offset, width and name are the header definition. Access direction is not stated; no code read reaches it, so its behaviour is unknown.

struct.name: PCI_ERR_UPPER

struct.name: BUF_ADDR_MATCH_LOWER
